# Preview fixtures

`password-protected.pdf` is a synthetic one-page PDF generated for the encrypted
PDF fallback test. It contains only the text “Synthetic encrypted fixture” and
uses PDF Standard Security revision 2. Test user password: `secret`; test owner
password: `owner`. These are public fixture credentials, not application secrets.
Other images, text samples, and multipage PDFs are generated by Qt in temporary
directories during tests.

GIF fixtures are synthetic solid-color images generated with Pillow (generation
only; Pillow is not a build or runtime dependency): animated.gif and
animated-once.gif have three 16 × 12 red/green/blue frames with delays of
80/120/160 ms. The former loops indefinitely; the latter has no loop extension.
animation-frame-limit.gif has 301 alternating 2 × 2 frames; animation-memory-limit.gif
has 17 alternating 2048 × 2048 frames. They exercise bounded animation fallback.
